Title: Azure Monitor for VMs is now available in South Central US, West US, Central US, North Central US, East Asia, and Central India regions

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for VMs (Preview) is now available in South Central US, West US, Central US, North Central US, East Asia, and Central India.  This includes the Performance and Map capabilities. Around the world, it is available in eighteen public regions.

Azure Monitor for VMs monitors your Azure virtual machines and virtual machine scale sets. It analyzes the performance and health of your Windows and Linux VMs, monitoring their processes and their dependencies on other resources and external processes.

As a solution, Azure Monitor for VMs includes support for monitoring performance and application dependencies for VMs that are hosted on-premises or with another cloud provider.

For more information, see the Azure Monitor for VMs documentation.
